draft.subject: Re: Picking back up with Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Glad to hear the first project is starting to click -- that's the right place to start, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. Both of your earlier questions (bulk import and the VAT number) are closed on our side, so nothing should be hanging over you there.

The natural next step is getting your team in alongside you -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. Want me to walk through that with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Priya
